source.sentence: (2.4) 2.1 Important Administration Instructions Administer levothyroxine sodium tablets as a single daily dose, on an empty stomach, one-half to one hour before breakfast with a full glass of water to avoid choking or gagging [see Adverse Reactions (6) ].

source.sentence: (2.1) Evaluate the need for dose adjustments when regularly administering within one hour of certain foods that may affect absorption.
